text: 金十数据7月28日讯，京东方A公告，公司控股股东、实际控制人北京电子控股有限责任公司计划自本公告披露之日起不超过6个月，拟以自有及自筹资金增持公司股份，增持金额不低于人民币5亿元且不超过10亿元。
text_en: Jin10 Data July 28: BOE A (000725.SZ) announced that its controlling shareholder and actual controller, Beijing Electronics Holding Co., Ltd., plans to increase its shareholding within no more than six months from the disclosure date, using own and self-raised funds of no less than 500 million yuan and no more than 1 billion yuan.
